name: Incendiary Aura
text:
You surround yourself with a combustible aura. Each time a creature within the emanation takes fire damage, it catches on fire, taking ceil(@item.level/2+1)d4 persistent,fire damage.

---
Heightened (+2) Increase the persistent damage by 1d4 and the radius of the emanation by 5 feet.

Spell Effect: Incendiary Aura
